audit.name: Spear-thrower

prereqAssessment.why: The dart is a hafted point; the thrower is a lever for a hafted projectile.

audit.ageGap: hafting A1 -> node A1
audit.effectRationale: Large game taken at range is a reserve when gathered food fails: a band absorbs a lean season instead of going hungry.
audit.costConcern: 180 is 0.57x the technology A1 median (315); within range.
audit.rationale: Sound A1 root of ranged hunting; feeds the war_band civic. Small food-security effect, distinct from the bow (range of movement) and sling (herds).

audit.name: Simple bow

prereqAssessment.why: A bow is useless without a strong fibre string; cordage is the binding requirement.

audit.ageGap: cordage A1 -> node A1
audit.effectRationale: Bow hunters feed themselves on the move from small and medium game, so a scouting party can push each step further into unknown ground.
audit.costConcern: 370 is 1.17x the technology A1 median (315); within range. Deferred entities: unit.archers (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep: the bow is the root of four later bows and feeds war_band. Units are not live, so the effect is the bow's provisioning role for parties on the move.

audit.name: Sling

prereqAssessment.why: The sling is two cords and a pouch.

audit.ageGap: cordage A1 -> node A1
audit.effectRationale: The sling is the shepherd's weapon: predators and thieves are driven off at range, so herds lose fewer animals.
audit.costConcern: 260 is 0.83x the technology A1 median (315); within range. Deferred entities: unit.slingers (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep. Effect follows the node's own capability (herd protection); it only bites once herding exists.

audit.name: Trepanation
audit.ageGap: knapping_blade A1 -> node A2
audit.effectRationale: Many trepanations treated depressed skull fractures; healed edges show survival above 50%.
audit.costConcern: 310 is 0.50x the technology A2 median (620); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf: a Neolithic surgical practice with no line to later medicine.

audit.name: Chariot

prereqAssessment.why: Light spoked wheels are what make the war chariot possible (Sintashta).

audit.ageGap: wheel_spoked A3, horse_domestication A3 -> node A3
audit.effectRationale: The chariot is an expensive platform crewed by a trained warrior elite (the maryannu): a specialist class the surplus must support.
audit.costConcern: 2090 is 1.19x the technology A3 median (1760); within range. Deferred entities: unit.chariot (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf: chariotry is superseded by cavalry rather than leading into it. Effect is the chariot elite as a specialist class.

audit.name: Composite bow
audit.ageGap: bow_simple A1, sheep_goat A2, hide_working A1 -> node A3
audit.effectRationale: A short bow usable from horseback lets mounted herders guard and work larger herds on open steppe.
audit.costConcern: 1760 is 1.00x the technology A3 median (1760); within range. Deferred entities: unit.horse_archers (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf (unit.horse_archers requires it). Herder effect is the steppe pastoral role; the A1 sling has the same operand in another Age and role.

audit.name: Medical texts
audit.ageGap: cuneiform A3, hieroglyphic A3, chinese_script A3 -> node A3
audit.effectRationale: Recorded prescriptions and case descriptions spread effective treatment beyond one healer's lifetime.
audit.costConcern: 880 is 0.50x the technology A3 median (1760); within range.
audit.newPrereq: herbal_remedies AND (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script)
audit.rationale: Add herbal_remedies: the earliest medical texts are mostly plant prescriptions (the Sumerian tablet, Ebers papyrus); what they write down is herbal lore. Script OR kept.

audit.name: Cavalry

prereqAssessment.why: Riding needs the domestic horse; nothing else is binding.

audit.ageGap: horse_domestication A3 -> node A4
audit.effectRationale: Mounted scouts cover several times the ground of foot parties: each exploration step reaches further.
audit.costConcern: 1240 is 0.50x the technology A4 median (2490); within range. Deferred entities: unit.horse_archers (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep. The classic role of light cavalry is scouting and screening.

audit.name: Saddle

prereqAssessment.why: The saddle improves riding that already exists.

audit.ageGap: cavalry A4, sewing A1 -> node A4; gaps of 3+ Ages (sewing) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: A padded seat makes long days in the saddle bearable, so riders and couriers cover more kilometres per day overland.
audit.costConcern: 1760 is 0.71x the technology A4 median (2490); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep; the bridge from cavalry to the stirrup.

audit.name: Battering ram

prereqAssessment.why: Wet hides protect the roof against fire.

audit.ageGap: wheel_solid A2, hide_working A1 -> node A4; gaps of 3+ Ages (hide_working) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Walled towns can no longer defy the centre behind their walls, so the reach of royal authority extends (Assyrian provincial system).
audit.costConcern: 4970 is 2.00x the technology A4 median (2490); within range. Deferred entities: unit.siege_engine (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep. Cost note: 4,970 is about 2x the A4 median and 5.6x its own dependent siege_tower; the integrator's recalibration should bring it into line.

audit.name: Siege tower and ramp

prereqAssessment.why: Tower and ramp complete the Assyrian assault kit that the ram began; dated two centuries after it.

audit.ageGap: siege_ram A4 -> node A4
audit.effectRationale: The assault ramp is organised mass earth-moving (Lachish): the same drilled labour gangs build paths faster.
audit.costConcern: 880 is 0.35x the technology A4 median (2490); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf. Effect follows the ramp, the part of the capability with a civil use.

audit.name: Crossbow

prereqAssessment.why: A bow mounted on a stock.
The Chinese trigger is a precision bronze casting.

audit.ageGap: bow_simple A1, casting_closed A3 -> node A4; gaps of 3+ Ages (bow_simple) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: A crossbow needs little training, so town militias can shoot back: banditry and disorder cost less output.
audit.costConcern: 4180 is 1.68x the technology A4 median (2490); within range. Deferred entities: unit.crossbowmen (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep; feeds torsion artillery and the repeating crossbow. Cost 4,180 is 1.7x the A4 median (precision casting justifies some of it).

audit.name: Ramming warship

prereqAssessment.why: A galley is a plank-built hull.
The bronze ram is cast in a closed mould.

audit.ageGap: plank_boat A3, casting_closed A3 -> node A4
audit.effectRationale: A war fleet suppresses piracy on sea lanes, so bulk sea haulage needs less escort and loses fewer cargoes.
audit.costConcern: 2960 is 1.19x the technology A4 median (2490); within range. Deferred entities: unit.war_galley (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep; feeds state_navy.

audit.name: Clinical medicine

prereqAssessment.why: Clinical medicine builds on the written record of cases.

audit.ageGap: medicine_recorded A3 -> node A4
audit.effectRationale: Trained physicians: the operand by which university medicine saves lives. Also the live hospital and university buildings.
audit.costConcern: 1760 is 0.71x the technology A4 median (2490); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep. Landmark node (six dependents, three live unlocks).

audit.name: Torsion catapult

prereqAssessment.why: The gastraphetes (belly-bow) is the stated ancestor of torsion engines.

audit.ageGap: crossbow A4 -> node A5
audit.effectRationale: Bolt-throwers on the walls let small garrisons hold frontier towns, extending the reach of administration.
audit.costConcern: 4970 is 1.41x the technology A5 median (3520); within range. Deferred entities: unit.siege_engine (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf. Philo's calibration formula (~250 BCE) is later than the node date but not a requirement.

audit.name: Repeating crossbow

prereqAssessment.why: A magazine added to the crossbow.

audit.ageGap: crossbow A4 -> node A5
audit.effectRationale: A cheap rapid-fire weapon for household and village defence: disorder costs less, and settler parties can defend themselves.
audit.costConcern: 1240 is 0.35x the technology A5 median (3520); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf. Paired effect keeps it distinct from the A4 crossbow's single unrest effect.

audit.name: Stirrup

prereqAssessment.why: The stirrup is fixed to a saddle.
The earliest (302 CE) stirrups were gilt bronze or wood, but the forms that spread with the Avars were iron; kept.

audit.ageGap: saddle A4, iron_bloomery A4 -> node A5
audit.effectRationale: Heavy horsemen maintained from estates enforce lordly and royal dues over the countryside: taxes extract more.
audit.costConcern: 2490 is 0.71x the technology A5 median (3520); within range. Deferred entities: unit.heavy_cavalry (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep. The link between stirrup and feudal levy is contested (White's thesis); the effect is stated as mounted coercion, not as the cause of feudalism.

audit.name: Pharmacopoeia

prereqAssessment.why: A catalogue of drugs and their effects is a clinical-medicine product.

audit.ageGap: medicine_hippocratic A4 -> node A5
audit.effectRationale: A transmissible materia medica raises what taught physicians can do. Live: building.hospital (with clinical medicine).
audit.costConcern: 1760 is 0.50x the technology A5 median (3520); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep. No longer a leaf: the new quinine node takes it as a prerequisite.

audit.name: Surgical instrument set

prereqAssessment.why: Bronze instruments; iron blades are not separately required.

audit.ageGap: medicine_hippocratic A4, casting_closed A3 -> node A5
audit.effectRationale: Trauma and cataract surgery with proper instruments save lives and sight.
audit.costConcern: 4180 is 1.19x the technology A5 median (3520); within range. Deferred entities: inst.military_medicine (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf for now. inst.military_medicine requires it, but institutions are not live.

audit.name: Early cannon

prereqAssessment.why: Gunpowder rich enough to propel needs refined saltpetre.
Bronze barrels are closed castings (OR branch).

audit.ageGap: saltpetre_refining A6, casting_closed A3, iron_bloomery A4 -> node A6; gaps of 3+ Ages (casting_closed) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Even weak guns let a ruler batter down a rebel's gate: the reach of central authority extends.
audit.costConcern: 7030 is 1.68x the technology A6 median (4180); within range. Deferred entities: unit.artillery (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep. OR between bronze casting and wrought iron is historically right (both barrel types existed).

audit.name: Counterweight trebuchet

prereqAssessment.why: The counterweight replaces the hauling crew.

audit.ageGap: traction_trebuchet A5 -> node A6
audit.effectRationale: Castles of magnates fall to the crown's engines, so dues long withheld behind walls are collected.
audit.costConcern: 5910 is 1.41x the technology A6 median (4180); within range. Deferred entities: unit.siege_engine (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Longbow

prereqAssessment.why: The longbow is a self bow scaled up; no other requirement is binding.

audit.ageGap: bow_simple A1 -> node A6; gaps of 3+ Ages (bow_simple) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Archery is practised by law in every parish and well paid in war; trained commoners rise into the yeomanry.
audit.costConcern: 2090 is 0.50x the technology A6 median (4180); within range. Deferred entities: unit.longbowmen (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Plate armour
audit.ageGap: tempering A4, sheet_metal A3 -> node A6; gaps of 3+ Ages (sheet_metal) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: A few armoured men-at-arms can put down a peasant rising (Jacquerie 1358): unrest is suppressed at less cost in output.
audit.costConcern: 5910 is 1.41x the technology A6 median (4180); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Greek fire

prereqAssessment.why: A distilled petroleum fraction is the most accepted reconstruction.

audit.ageGap: distillation A5 -> node A6
audit.effectRationale: A fleet armed with a feared incendiary holds sea lanes against raiders, lowering the cost of sea haulage.
audit.costConcern: 2090 is 0.50x the technology A6 median (4180); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf: a lost state secret with no successor.

audit.name: Cast bronze cannon

prereqAssessment.why: One-piece casting; it is redundant only on cannon_early's bronze branch, so it is kept.

audit.ageGap: cannon_early A6, casting_closed A3 -> node A7; gaps of 3+ Ages (casting_closed) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Siege trains end the castle as a refuge (Constantinople 1453, French Italy 1494): central authority reaches much further.
audit.costConcern: 7030 is 1.00x the technology A7 median (7030); within range. Deferred entities: unit.artillery (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep; landmark of the gunpowder state, slightly larger delta.

audit.name: Cast iron cannon

prereqAssessment.why: Iron guns follow the bronze designs.
Cast iron in gun-sized quantity needs the blast furnace.

audit.ageGap: cannon_cast_bronze A7, blast_furnace_water A6 -> node A7
audit.effectRationale: Iron guns at a quarter the price arm ordinary merchantmen, which then sail without escort: cheaper bulk haulage by sea.
audit.costConcern: 7030 is 1.00x the technology A7 median (7030); within range. Deferred entities: unit.artillery (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Matchlock arquebus

prereqAssessment.why: The hand gun descends from the cannon.
Corned powder makes small arms reliable.

audit.ageGap: cannon_early A6, corned_powder A7 -> node A7
audit.effectRationale: Gunpowder infantry is the military revolution that builds the fiscal-military state: armies paid by taxes collect taxes.
audit.costConcern: 4180 is 0.59x the technology A7 median (7030); within range. Deferred entities: unit.musketeers (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Wheellock

prereqAssessment.why: A new ignition on the same gun.

audit.ageGap: matchlock A7, escapement_verge A6 -> node A7
audit.effectRationale: Pistols for mounted patrols: highway robbery is policed, so roads are travelled faster and disorder costs less.
audit.costConcern: 2960 is 0.42x the technology A7 median (7030); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep; bridge from matchlock to flintlock.

audit.name: Flintlock

prereqAssessment.why: Snaphance and flintlock simplify the wheellock's self-ignition.

audit.ageGap: wheellock A7 -> node A7
audit.effectRationale: A cheap, reliable musket in every settler's hands lets founding parties strike out larger and further (colonial frontiers).
audit.costConcern: 2960 is 0.42x the technology A7 median (7030); within range. Deferred entities: unit.musketeers (not live).
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Bastion fort

prereqAssessment.why: It is the answer to the bronze gun.
Bastion traces are designed by geometry.

audit.ageGap: cannon_cast_bronze A7, geometry_axiomatic A5, stone_fortification A4 -> node A7; gaps of 3+ Ages (stone_fortification) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Live unlock: building.bastion_fort requires it.
audit.costConcern: 5910 is 0.84x the technology A7 median (7030); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep. Live entity unlock is its real effect.

audit.name: Ship of the line

prereqAssessment.why: Dozens of guns per ship need cheap iron guns.

audit.ageGap: carrack A7, cannon_cast_iron A7 -> node A7
audit.effectRationale: Sea control keeps convoy routes open in war, so distant markets stay connected and price gaps close.
audit.costConcern: 4180 is 0.59x the technology A7 median (7030); within range. Deferred entities: unit.ship_of_the_line (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Variolation

prereqAssessment.why: Deliberate infection as treatment is a clinical practice.

audit.ageGap: medicine_hippocratic A4 -> node A7; gaps of 3+ Ages (medicine_hippocratic) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Variolation cut smallpox mortality from about 30% to 1-2% in those treated.
audit.costConcern: 2960 is 0.42x the technology A7 median (7030); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep; leads to vaccination.

audit.name: Systematic anatomy

prereqAssessment.why: Galenic medicine is what Vesalius corrected.
The Fabrica's illustrations needed accurate print.

audit.ageGap: medicine_hippocratic A4, printing_press A7 -> node A7; gaps of 3+ Ages (medicine_hippocratic) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Accurate anatomy taught in university theatres makes surgery and diagnosis safer.
audit.costConcern: 2960 is 0.42x the technology A7 median (7030); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Vaccination
audit.ageGap: inoculation A7 -> node A8
audit.effectRationale: Safe immunisation against the largest single killer of the eighteenth century.
audit.costConcern: 11830 is 0.71x the technology A8 median (16730); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep; landmark, larger delta.

audit.name: Surgical anaesthesia

prereqAssessment.why: Ether and chloroform are chemical preparations.

audit.ageGap: chemistry_quantitative A8, anatomy_dissection A7 -> node A8
audit.effectRationale: Painless surgery lets teaching hospitals perform long operations.
audit.costConcern: 5910 is 0.35x the technology A8 median (16730); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Germ theory

prereqAssessment.why: Microbes are seen with the microscope.

audit.ageGap: microscope A7 -> node A8
audit.effectRationale: Specific microbes, specific diseases; and Pasteur's work on spoilage microbes cuts losses in store. Live: infra.sewerage_system (OR route).
audit.costConcern: 47310 is 2.83x the technology A8 median (16730); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.
audit.rationale: Keep. Single prerequisite is thin (Pasteur's chemistry and Koch's aniline stains are not required) but the closure is acceptable; cost 47,310 is 2.8x the A8 median.

audit.name: Antiseptic and aseptic surgery

prereqAssessment.why: Long operations created the infection problem.

audit.ageGap: germ_theory A8, anaesthesia A8 -> node A8
audit.effectRationale: Surgical mortality collapses; childbed fever falls with aseptic midwifery.
audit.costConcern: 5910 is 0.35x the technology A8 median (16730); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Tank
audit.prereq: internal_combustion AND basic_process AND rifled_artillery AND machine_gun AND mechanised_agriculture

prereqAssessment.why: Secondary armament and the trench problem it answered.
Caterpillar track from the Holt tractor.

audit.ageGap: internal_combustion A8, basic_process A8, rifled_artillery A8, machine_gun A8, mechanised_agriculture A9 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Armoured columns project force over long distances without roads: administrative reach extends.
audit.costConcern: 23650 is 0.50x the technology A9 median (47310); within range. Deferred entities: unit.tank (not live).
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf. Five-way AND is heavy but each atom is a real component.

audit.name: Radar
audit.ageGap: vacuum_tube A9, electromagnetic_field_theory A8 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Detection beyond sight: formations see much further, and ships navigate in fog and darkness, lowering haulage costs.
audit.costConcern: 23650 is 0.50x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep; landmark sensor node, four dependents.

audit.name: Thermonuclear weapon

prereqAssessment.why: A fission primary ignites the fusion stage.

audit.ageGap: fission_weapon A9 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Weapons laboratories and their university contracts (Livermore, Los Alamos) grow new research faculties quickly.
audit.costConcern: 47310 is 1.00x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep. No live mechanic; the effect is the Cold War research spillover.

audit.name: Penicillin

prereqAssessment.why: Deep-tank fermentation is the mass-production method; the A2 atom stands for fermentation craft.

audit.ageGap: germ_theory A8, fermentation_grain A2 -> node A9; gaps of 3+ Ages (fermentation_grain) are standing components, not a reason to change the edge
audit.effectRationale: Bacterial infection cured: wound and maternal mortality collapse.
audit.costConcern: 94620 is 2.00x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep; landmark. Cost 94,620 is 2x the A9 median.

audit.name: Broad-spectrum antibiotics
audit.ageGap: antibiotic_penicillin A9 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Tuberculosis becomes curable; it chronically disabled working adults, so cured farmers produce more.
audit.costConcern: 23650 is 0.50x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Antibiotic resistance management
audit.ageGap: antibiotic_broad A9, evolution A8, epidemiology A8 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Stewardship keeps hospital and famine-camp infections treatable.
audit.costConcern: 33450 is 0.71x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Laboratory vaccines

prereqAssessment.why: Vaccines designed from the isolated pathogen.

audit.ageGap: germ_theory A8, vaccination A8 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Childhood vaccines (diphtheria, polio, measles) cut child mortality, including in hungry years.
audit.costConcern: 33450 is 0.71x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Keep in A9: the node spans 1885-1955 and its bulk (polio, measles) is post-1914. Data note: its emerged text marks only 1955 CE, so the validator dates it after its dependent immunology (1890 CE).

audit.name: Blood transfusion
audit.ageGap: immunology A9, physiology A7 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Surgical and trauma survival through stored, matched blood.
audit.costConcern: 16730 is 0.35x the technology A9 median (47310); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.
audit.rationale: Keep.

audit.name: Oral contraceptive
audit.ageGap: endocrinology A9, synthetic_dye A8 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Fertility by choice let women complete education and enter careers (the 'power of the pill'): faster social promotion.
audit.costConcern: 47310 is 1.00x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: X-ray imaging
audit.ageGap: electromagnetism A8, barometer_vacuum A7, photography A8 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Diagnosis without cutting in hospitals; X-ray crystallography becomes a university instrument.
audit.costConcern: 66910 is 1.41x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Move A9 to A8 by its own date (1895, Röntgen) and by its use by 1914; all prerequisites are A7-A8 and all four dependents are A9, so no edge or sweep is affected.

audit.name: Organ transplantation

audit.ageGap: antisepsis A8, blood_transfusion A9 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: Transplant programmes concentrate in academic medical centres.
audit.costConcern: 8360 is 0.18x the technology A9 median (47310); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.

audit.name: Chemotherapy

audit.costConcern: 16730 is 0.35x the technology A9 median (47310); outlier, for the pacing recalibration.

audit.name: Cross-sectional imaging

audit.name: Antiviral drugs

audit.costConcern: 23650 is 0.50x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: Monoclonal antibodies

audit.costConcern: 47310 is 1.00x the technology A9 median (47310); within range.
audit.rationale: Deliberate leaf.

audit.name: In-vitro fertilisation
audit.ageGap: endocrinology A9 -> node A9

audit.name: mRNA vaccines

audit.name: Intercontinental ballistic missile

prereqAssessment.why: Megaton warhead small enough to lift.

audit.ageGap: rocket A9, thermonuclear A9, computer A9 -> node A9
audit.effectRationale: The ICBM-launched Sputnik produced mass science education programmes (US NDEA 1958): faster social promotion through education.
audit.costConcern: 189240 is 4.00x the technology A9 median (47310); outlier, for the pacing recalibration. Deferred entities: unit.icbm (not live).

newNodes.name: Herbal remedies
newNodes.emerged: ~49 kya El Sidrón (Neanderthal dental calculus with poplar and chamomile, contested); ~3,300 BCE Ötzi's birch polypore
newNodes.prereqRationale: fire_making: infusions, decoctions and fumigation need fire; the hearth is where plant preparations are made. Dated far earlier than the node.
newNodes.rationale: fire_making: infusions, decoctions and fumigation need fire; the hearth is where plant preparations are made. Dated far earlier than the node.
newNodes.desc: Knowledge of plants that ease pain, purge worms and dress wounds, passed from healer to healer. The root of every later pharmacopoeia.
newNodes.effectRationale: Willow and poplar bark for pain, anthelmintic fungi and wound dressings slightly lower everyday mortality.
newNodes.distinctFrom: pharmacology (A5) is a written, systematic catalogue; herbal remedies are oral lore, 45,000 years earlier, and the root medicine_recorded writes down.

newNodes.name: Signal beacons
newNodes.emerged: ~1,770 BCE Mari (fire signals reported to Zimri-Lim); beacon towers on Chinese frontiers by ~800 BCE
newNodes.prereqRationale: fire_making: a beacon is a prepared fire. stone_dry: posts are towers and cairns on heights. Both far older than the node.
newNodes.rationale: fire_making: a beacon is a prepared fire. stone_dry: posts are towers and cairns on heights. Both far older than the node.
newNodes.desc: Chains of watch posts on high ground pass a pre-arranged fire or smoke signal from hilltop to hilltop: news of raiders reaches the capital in hours instead of days.
newNodes.effectRationale: Warnings and simple orders cross a province in hours, so the centre can respond at distance: administrative reach extends.
newNodes.distinctFrom: optical_telegraph (A7) sends arbitrary coded messages along a line; beacons carry one pre-agreed signal, 3,500 years earlier, for frontier warning.

newNodes.name: Antiscorbutics
newNodes.emerged: 1747 CE (Lind's citrus trial aboard HMS Salisbury); 1795 CE (Royal Navy lemon-juice issue)
newNodes.prereqRationale: medicine_hippocratic: Lind's comparative trial is clinical observation. carrack: months-long ocean voyages created mass scurvy. Both centuries older.
newNodes.rationale: medicine_hippocratic: Lind's comparative trial is clinical observation. carrack: months-long ocean voyages created mass scurvy. Both centuries older.
newNodes.desc: Citrus juice and fresh food prevent scurvy, which killed more sailors on long voyages than storms or battle. Crews and emigrants arrive alive.
newNodes.effectRationale: Crews and emigrants survive months at sea, so migrants travel further and voyages of exploration range wider.
newNodes.distinctFrom: inoculation (A7) protects against one infection; antiscorbutics prevent a deficiency disease of long voyages, with a migration and exploration effect, not mortality.

newNodes.name: Quinine
newNodes.emerged: 1820 CE (quinine isolated by Pelletier and Caventou, Paris); 1854 CE (prophylaxis on Baikie's Niger expedition); cinchona bark known from the seventeenth century
newNodes.prereqRationale: pharmacology: cinchona bark entered the pharmacopoeias first. chemistry_quantitative (1789): isolating the alkaloid is analytical chemistry. Both predate 1820.
newNodes.rationale: pharmacology: cinchona bark entered the pharmacopoeias first. chemistry_quantitative (1789): isolating the alkaloid is analytical chemistry. Both predate 1820.
newNodes.desc: The alkaloid of cinchona bark, isolated and dosed, prevents and treats malaria. Settlers and soldiers survive in malarial lands that had killed most newcomers.
newNodes.effectRationale: Founding parties survive malarial country (the West African 'white man's grave'), so larger parties can be sent; endemic malaria deaths fall slightly.
newNodes.distinctFrom: pharmacology (A5) catalogues drugs; quinine is one purified, dosed alkaloid against the deadliest endemic disease, with a colonization effect.

newNodes.name: Aerial reconnaissance
newNodes.emerged: 1911 CE (Italian aircraft over Libya); 1914–1918 CE (photographic reconnaissance on the Western Front)
newNodes.prereqRationale: aircraft (1903 CE): the platform. photography (1839 CE): reconnaissance became systematic with aerial cameras and photo interpretation.
newNodes.rationale: aircraft (1903 CE): the platform. photography (1839 CE): reconnaissance became systematic with aerial cameras and photo interpretation.
newNodes.desc: Aircraft with cameras photograph the land beyond the front and far from home. Maps of unseen country are made from the air.
newNodes.effectRationale: Aerial photography and survey reveal country far beyond ground parties' reach: exploration range grows.
newNodes.distinctFrom: radar (A9) detects by radio at night and in cloud for air defence; aerial reconnaissance photographs terrain by daylight, decades earlier, and maps land rather than tracking targets.

findings: Dependency and Age changes proposed: 4. medicine_recorded adds the new herbal_remedies (early medical texts are herbal prescriptions). oral_rehydration adds physiology (ORT rests on 1960s sodium-glucose co-transport). missile_defence replaces guided_munitions with guided_missile AND computer (interceptors descend from guided missiles, not laser-guided bombs). xray moves A9 to A8 by its own 1895 date; its prerequisites are A7-A8 and its four dependents A9, so no edge or sweep is affected.

Gap fill: 5 new nodes. Medicine: herbal_remedies (A1; the lane had no A1 root), antiscorbutics (A7; scurvy, the killer of long voyages, uses the migration and exploration operands), quinine (A8; malaria had no node; colonization operand). Military: signal_beacons (A3; nothing before the A7 optical telegraph gave fast long-distance warning) and aerial_reconnaissance (A9; aircraft existed with no military reconnaissance role).

Structural: medicine is a deep, mostly linear lane (A2 trepanation is a dead end; A6 is empty because medieval medicine is covered by the hospital entity and the public_health_board civic). Military has 13 A9 nodes, most of them deliberate leaves.

Effects: units are not live, so 42 of 43 military nodes rely on registry spillovers (authority reach, tax extraction, unrest drag, exploration and sight, trade haulage, and the specialist-class operands). Only trace_italienne has a live unlock (building.bastion_fort). Modern weapons (fission, thermonuclear, ICBM, missiles) have no civil channel, so they carry small university or education spillovers. Recommend a combat operand family once M7/M8 combat is live, then re-point these nodes. Some A9 medicine nodes share an operand pair (penicillin, chemotherapy and endocrinology; imaging and nuclear medicine), but each pair covers a different clinical role, and no two nodes in a lane and Age share a single effect.

Operand pressure: demographics.mortalityPerYear is the medicine lane's natural operand. Other groups already sum to 0.37 against a cap of 0.7. This group adds 0.29 (medicine 0.29), giving about 0.66, so most medicine deltas here are 0.01-0.02 and only vaccination (0.05) and penicillin (0.04) are larger. Hospital and surgical nodes use institutions.universities.maxMortalityReduction (+0.35, cap 2.0), and child and famine nodes use the starvation operands. Further mortality from later groups will cross the cap, so the integrator should rescale.

Chronology data issues (not changed): vaccine_lab's emerged text ('1885 / 1955 CE') marks only 1955, so the validator dates it after its dependent immunology (1890 CE). blood_transfusion has the same pattern. immunology (1890/1901), endocrinology (1902/1922) and radiotherapy (1901/1951) carry A8 dates but sit in A9 behind A9 prerequisites.

Pacing: cost outliers are oral_rehydration (740 RP in A9, 0.016x the median), siege_tower vs siege_ram (880 vs 4,970 in A4), organ_transplant (8,360, 0.18x A9) and icbm (189,240, 4x A9). They are left to the per-(tree, Age) recalibration.
